column1: # Stage S5 D1a — crate births of mission_model and mission_payload. Paths name the tree before the moves.

# mission_model; the extensions module root becomes the crate root and its README the source README
# the payload compiler becomes mission_payload, its module root the crate root; the kit aliases
# join it as the kit_aliases module
# the moved compiled rows name their siblings and the win rule inside mission_model; the authoring
# structs that stay behind name the block registry in mission_model
# the extension blocks name the registry and each other inside mission_model
# the payload compiler and the game-document compiler name the registry and the ORBAT projection
# in mission_model; the payload tests name the payload compiler from its crate root
# the game-document compiler and the validator name the payload crate and the model's blocks
